IC2: Patients with a diagnosis of glaucoma
IC3: Any abnormality of the cornea which may prevent reliable applanation tonometry
IC4: Known allergy/ h [OR]ypersensitivity re [AND]action to Brimonidine
IC5: Contra-indication to  [AND]Brimonidine including patients on monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MOA)
